chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Zurara, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
The woman who has been given a triple divorce has no maintenance (nafaqah) upon her husband. Rather, that is for the woman upon whom her husband has a right of reversion.
ai.seo_question: Does a woman divorced three times receive maintenance from her husband?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi delineates the financial rights of a woman in a triple divorce (ṭalāq thalāth), establishing that she is not entitled to maintenance (nafaqah) because the divorce is final and irrevocable. It contrasts this with the revocable divorce (rajʿiyyah), where the husband retains the right to take her back during the waiting period (ʿiddah), thereby necessitating continued financial support. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential link between the revocability of the marriage bond and the obligation of maintenance.
